'''Vallkos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who was the brother of [[Mallikhan]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, Vallkos and Mallikhan traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Volik]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], as part of a large band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. However, following a dispute over a female, the pirate gang split into two rival factions: the [[Crimson Stars]] and the [[Ebon Strikers]]. Vallkos became the leader of the Crimson Stars, while Mallikhan assumed control of the Ebon Strikers, and the two groups feuded with one another.<ref name="TUR" />
